name: Eshki Dragonclaw
description: The khan who commanded the Temur rebellion against Atarka.

description_citations.text: "Temur Frontier". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: He Who Whispers Twice marks Surrak as the First Father of the Temur, giving him a bearskin cloak and gauntlets made from the bear's paws.
timeline.quote: He Who Whispers Twice spoke the invocation that marked Surrak as the First Father of the Temur.

citation.text: "Awakening the Bear" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Eshki beats Surrak in a wrestling match to prove her right to lead the rebellion.
timeline.quote: Eshki Dragonclaw commanded the Temur rebellion against Atarka, beating Surrak in a wrestling match to prove her right to lead.

citation.text: "Temur Frontier", section "Khans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The performers change masks to portray the five rebellion leaders, each clan's hero.
timeline.quote: they were masked again, this time in the images of Eshki Dragonclaw and Alniul, the Twice Whisperer

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones " by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Eshki wrestles a camp champion at a festival and pins him.
timeline.quote: Before he knows what's happened to him, she's got him pinned.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Alniul arrives with a hunter carrying a stag with glowing blue eyes and asks to speak to Ureni.
timeline.quote: We need to speak to Ureni.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Eshki and Alniul visit Ureni, who tells them it cannot give guidance and that they have two weeks.
timeline.quote: Two weeks.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Alniul climbs alone beyond a sacred boundary to speak with the spirits and returns weakened, naming Rainveil.
timeline.quote: Rainveil,

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Eshki and Alniul travel toward Rainveil Forest, tending to the dead and quelling those who would abandon the sick.
timeline.quote: We do not leave our clan behind,

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: They find a whole camp dead around a burned-out fire, and Eshki weeps that night and remembers their names.
timeline.quote: But, that night, she lets herself weep, and she remembers their names.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: They enter silent Rainveil Forest and follow blue streams to a glowing lake where Surrak lies wounded.
timeline.quote: Surrak is paler than Eshki has ever seen him.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Surrak, bound to the cursed ground, tells Eshki to leave him and argues that the weak should be left behind.
timeline.quote: Everything has to die.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Alniul stops Eshki and Surrak from fighting with walls of frost and gets Surrak to agree to help.
timeline.quote: both Eshki and Alniul hear the painful rattle of it.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Alniul begins the ritual song with Eshki and Surrak at their sides, summoning snow visions of spirits.
timeline.quote: they begin to sing.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: The spirits of those who died in the forest voice their sins of survival, and Alniul asks Eshki whether she welcomes them.
timeline.quote: do you welcome those who have transgressed in the name of survival?

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Eshki remembers how she wounded Surrak with ice and recognizes she cast aside the spirits too.
timeline.quote: When she drove the ice into Surrak's chest, she told herself she'd done it for the sake of progress.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Eshki welcomes everyone to the fire and brings Surrak into the song, and a reindeer wanders into the clearing at dawn.
timeline.quote: And as dawn breaks on Rainveil Forest, a reindeer wanders into the clearing.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Months later, Eshki, Alniul and Surrak share a meal and Surrak vows to take back his clan someday.
timeline.quote: I will take back my clan from you one day.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Eshki is chosen as Dragonclaw by the whisperers and proves herself in battle.
timeline.quote: Some had doubted the whisperers' choice of Eshki for Dragonclaw.

citation.text: Dragonclaw Strike (Tarkir: Dragonstorm, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After her hunting group is attacked by one of Atarka's brood, Eshki escapes into the mountains and meets Alniul.
timeline.quote: When her hunting group was attacked by one of Atarka's brood and left for dead, Eshki had enough.

citation.text: "Eshki", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eshki takes charge of the scattered Atarka forces during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Eshki took charge of the scattered Atarka forces to fight back against the invaders.

citation.text: "Eshki", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Surrak challenges Eshki; she defeats him, is appointed Dragonclaw, and the rebellion succeeds.
timeline.quote: She was appointed Dragonclaw, and the rebellion was ultimately successful.

citation.text: "Eshki", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Stormnexus Ritual, Eshki calls the spirit dragon Ureni into being.
timeline.quote: Eshki called the spirit dragon Ureni into being

citation.text: "Eshki", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eshki, Alniul and Surrak end the blight by pledging all would be welcome at the Temur fires; Surrak rejoins the clan.
timeline.quote: They pledged that all would be welcome at the fires of the Temur, and the blight was brought to an end.

citation.text: "Eshki", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The khans perform the ritual at the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon, raising five spirit dragons bound to them.
timeline.quote: Narset shaped the first into Shiko

citation.text: "Stormnexus Ritual", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Narset is appointed Waymaster of the Jeskai Way and the other khans lead their clans with their spirit dragons.
timeline.quote: Narset was appointed Waymaster of the Jeskai Way

citation.text: "Stormnexus Ritual", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Surrak challenges Eshki, leader of the Temur rebellion, and is defeated and forced to surrender.
timeline.quote: Eshki came out on top, proving her strength in front of Surrak's army

citation.text: "Surrak", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Surrak survives a blight spreading from his village; Eshki and Alniul find him near death.
timeline.quote: Eshki and the Twice Whisperer Alniul came to investigate the blight

citation.text: "Surrak", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The three commune with the land's spirits and pledge that all are welcome at the Temur fires, ending the blight; Surrak rejoins the clan.
timeline.quote: They pledged that all would be welcome at the fires of the Temur, and the blight was brought to an end.

citation.text: "Surrak", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2025.
